ticket.title: Ticket
ticket.description: A Jira key such as PAY-142, or a GitHub issue such as acme/payments#42

base_branch.title: Base branch
base_branch.description: The branch to build on and open the pull request against. Name the integration branch (for example dev): the repository default can be hundreds of commits behind it, and the plan would then miss code the ticket refers to.

confluence_page.title: Confluence page
confluence_page.description: Optional numeric id of one Confluence page (spec, PRD or design) that gives context for the ticket. Leave empty for none.

def.description: Read the ticket from Jira or from GitHub.
Read the Jira ticket through the Atlassian MCP server.
Read the GitHub issue and its first comments.
Turn the Jira ticket or GitHub issue into one plain ticket (key, title, description, priority, reporter).
Read a Confluence page only when one was given.
Read the Confluence page through the Atlassian MCP server.

The ticket every later step reads: the normalized ticket plus, when a Confluence page was given, its text under a Linked Confluence context heading (same fields, description capped at 20,000 characters).
Run the test command on the untouched base branch with a do-nothing agent, so a repository whose tests cannot run is found before any expensive step.
Plan and build only when the base branch passes its own tests.
The base branch passed its own tests.
Say the base branch fails its own tests, so nothing was built.

message.cel: 'STOPPED ' + nodes.intake.output.key + ': the tests already fail on ' + (has(inputs.base_branch) && inputs.base_branch != '' ? inputs.base_branch : 'the default branch') + ' of ' + inputs.repo + ', so nothing was built. Fix the tests or the environment, then run again.'

def.description: Write the requirements and the design in one grounded pass over the repository (requirements-brief, implementation-plan and decision-rubric skills).
Propose the weight of the change from the design's signals: full when the risk is high, a sensitive area or a migration is touched, the change is wide, or confidence is low; otherwise lite.
def.expression: nodes.plan.output.design.risk == 'high' || nodes.plan.output.design.touches_sensitive || nodes.plan.output.design.has_migration || size(nodes.plan.output.design.files) > config.lite_max_files || nodes.plan.output.design.confidence < config.lite_min_confidence ? 'full' : 'lite'

def.description: A senior engineer answers the open questions, confirms the design and the review path (lite or full) before any code is written.

message.cel: 'Approve the design for ' + nodes.intake.output.key + ': ' + nodes.plan.output.design.summary + '? Proposed review path: ' + nodes.weight_proposal.output.route + ' (risk ' + nodes.plan.output.design.risk + ', ' + string(size(nodes.plan.output.design.files)) + ' file(s)). Answer the ' + string(size(nodes.plan.output.requirements.open_questions) + size(nodes.plan.output.design.open_questions)) + ' open question(s) first.' + (nodes.plan.output.requirements.criteria_source == 'ticket' ? '' : ' The ticket did not state all its acceptance criteria; the ' + nodes.plan.output.requirements.criteria_source + ' ones are the reading of the request by the planner, so check them.')

payload.map: {'open_questions': nodes.plan.output.requirements.open_questions + nodes.plan.output.design.open_questions, 'requirements': nodes.plan.output.requirements, 'design': nodes.plan.output.design, 'proposed_weight': {'path': nodes.weight_proposal.output.route, 'risk': nodes.plan.output.design.risk, 'risk_reasons': nodes.plan.output.design.risk_reasons, 'sensitive': nodes.plan.output.design.touches_sensitive, 'migration': nodes.plan.output.design.has_migration, 'files': size(nodes.plan.output.design.files), 'confidence': nodes.plan.output.design.confidence}}

answers.title: Answers to the open questions
answers.description: One answer per open question, or: use the recommended defaults

def.description: v2 has one review path: one independent reviewer, one verifier and a single fix round. Sensitive or migration changes still open as a draft pull request for a person.
Implement the approved plan in the checkout; the worker then runs the tests (implement-change and ai-sdlc-governance skills).

input.map: {'environment': {'tests_unavailable': false, 'verification': 'full', 'scope': null}, 'ticket': nodes.intake.output, 'requirements': nodes.plan.output.requirements, 'design': nodes.plan.output.design, 'decisions': nodes.design_review.output.data}

def.description: The build, with the repository's own tests.
One pass over correctness, tests and security of the first build (lite path).

input.map: {'scope': null, 'requirements': nodes.plan.output.requirements, 'design': nodes.plan.output.design, 'change': {'summary': nodes.change_1.output.summary, 'deviations': nodes.change_1.output.deviations, 'tests_added': nodes.change_1.output.tests_added, 'stats': nodes.change_1.output.workspace.stats, 'diff': nodes.change_1.output.workspace.diff, 'diff_truncated': nodes.change_1.output.workspace.diff_truncated, 'tests': nodes.change_1.output.workspace.tests}}

def.description: Try to refute the review only when it reported a critical or major finding; with none there is nothing to check.
Try to refute the critical and major findings of lite review 1 in a fresh checkout (finding-verification skill, a different model).

input.map: {'requirements': nodes.plan.output.requirements, 'design': nodes.plan.output.design, 'change': {'summary': nodes.change_1.output.summary, 'deviations': nodes.change_1.output.deviations, 'tests_added': nodes.change_1.output.tests_added, 'stats': nodes.change_1.output.workspace.stats, 'diff': nodes.change_1.output.workspace.diff, 'diff_truncated': nodes.change_1.output.workspace.diff_truncated, 'tests': nodes.change_1.output.workspace.tests}, 'findings': [{'reviewer': 'lite', 'findings': nodes.lite_review_1.output.findings.filter(f, (f.severity == 'critical' || f.severity == 'major'))}]}

def.description: The verifier's checks, or none when the verifier was skipped because the review had no critical or major finding.

Approved when no reviewer reported a prompt injection and no critical or major finding was confirmed by the verifier with enough confidence and the criteria auditor found no confirmed counterexample to a criterion rated met; otherwise a fix round.
def.expression: [nodes.lite_review_1.output].all(v, !v.prompt_injection_detected && (v.approved || v.findings.exists(f, (f.severity == 'critical' || f.severity == 'major'))) && !v.findings.exists(f, (f.severity == 'critical' || f.severity == 'major') && nodes.lite_checks.output.checks.exists(c, c.id == f.id && c.verdict == 'confirmed' && c.confidence >= config.min_confidence))) ? 'ok' : 'fix'

def.description: Fix the reviewer's critical and major findings (lite path, the only fix round).

input.map: {'environment': {'tests_unavailable': false, 'verification': 'full', 'scope': null}, 'ticket': nodes.intake.output, 'requirements': nodes.plan.output.requirements, 'design': nodes.plan.output.design, 'decisions': nodes.design_review.output.data, 'feedback': {'round': 1, 'previous_summary': nodes.change_1.output.summary, 'previous_diff': nodes.change_1.output.workspace.diff, 'verdicts': [nodes.lite_review_1.output].map(v, {'approved': v.approved, 'summary': v.summary, 'prompt_injection_detected': v.prompt_injection_detected, 'findings': v.findings.filter(f, !(f.severity == 'critical' || f.severity == 'major') || nodes.lite_checks.output.checks.exists(c, c.id == f.id && c.verdict == 'confirmed' && c.confidence >= config.min_confidence))})}}

def.description: The fix round, with the repository's own tests.
Review the fix only when it changed the diff; an identical diff has nothing new to review.
Review the fixed change (lite path).

input.map: {'scope': null, 'requirements': nodes.plan.output.requirements, 'design': nodes.plan.output.design, 'change': {'summary': nodes.change_2.output.summary, 'deviations': nodes.change_2.output.deviations, 'tests_added': nodes.change_2.output.tests_added, 'stats': nodes.change_2.output.workspace.stats, 'diff': nodes.change_2.output.workspace.diff, 'diff_truncated': nodes.change_2.output.workspace.diff_truncated, 'tests': nodes.change_2.output.workspace.tests}}

def.description: Same for the review of the fix.

input.map: {'requirements': nodes.plan.output.requirements, 'design': nodes.plan.output.design, 'change': {'summary': nodes.change_2.output.summary, 'deviations': nodes.change_2.output.deviations, 'tests_added': nodes.change_2.output.tests_added, 'stats': nodes.change_2.output.workspace.stats, 'diff': nodes.change_2.output.workspace.diff, 'diff_truncated': nodes.change_2.output.workspace.diff_truncated, 'tests': nodes.change_2.output.workspace.tests}, 'findings': [{'reviewer': 'lite', 'findings': nodes.lite_review_2.output.findings.filter(f, (f.severity == 'critical' || f.severity == 'major'))}]}

def.description: Pick the last build that ran, aggregate its verdicts (approved only if no critical or major finding survived the verifier, no injection) and write the evidence record.

def.description: Ship to approval only when the tests passed and there is a change. A confirmed critical finding, an unmet acceptance criterion, criteria the reviewer did not judge, or a build that ran out of steps sends it back instead (see blockers in finalize). Major findings and below flag the pull request for a person.
The release owner approves the exact change, its reviews and its evidence record before a branch is pushed.

message.cel: 'Push ' + string(nodes.finalize.output.change.stats.files) + ' changed file(s) for ' + nodes.intake.output.key + ' to ' + inputs.repo + ' and open a ' + (nodes.finalize.output.needs_human_attention ? 'draft ' : '') + 'pull request? Tests ' + nodes.finalize.output.change.tests.status + ', review path ' + nodes.weight.output.route + (nodes.finalize.output.needs_human_attention ? ', reviewers still have critical or major findings' : ', reviewers approve') + '.' + (nodes.finalize.output.verification == 'none' ? ' WARNING: UNTESTED - nothing could run, so this opens as a draft.' : (nodes.finalize.output.verification == 'static' ? ' NOTICE: static checks only (typecheck and build) - the tests could not run, so this opens as a draft.' : ''))
